decisions.reason: Having survived another year as a low-cost aesthetic extension of the core drainage range, it is likely meeting aspiration levels well enough for management to keep it.

The pump-assisted line remains the most vulnerable because its niche and technical complexity can still fall short of aspirations, but the firm's continued investment in this solution area and available slack support keeping it.
As a design-oriented complement to the existing portfolio with relatively low resource demands, it is likely to remain on the market unless results clearly slip below aspiration levels.

Because the pump-drain shower channel is still new, strategically aligned with barrier-free bathroom innovation, and not yet fully judged against aspirations, management is likely to give it more time.
